title: Rewind of the cleaned configuration
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer and let $w$ and $s$ be Boolean words, and fix any valid input-head position $p$ for input $w$. For every $j\in\mathbb N$ with $j\le |s|$, running the cleanup machine for $j+1$ steps from state $(1,\mathrm{false})$, with input head at $p$, the first work tape storing $s$, all scratch tapes blank, and all work heads at displacement $j-1$, yields the configuration in state $(2,\mathrm{false})$ with the same input-head position and tape contents and all work heads at displacement $0$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a valid input-head position for $w$
replaced:
For every $j$ at most the candidate's length, exactly $j+1$ steps of the
cleanup machine from the cleaned configuration with all work heads at
displacement $j-1$ yield the cleaned configuration of the next phase with
every work head at displacement $0$; no candidate bit is altered.
